scope: CW semantic availability for downstream models

value_condition.construction: event_condition Link with condition_mode=value_equals and explicit expected_value
value_condition.rule: Parent Data must be READY before exact type-preserving comparison; UNBOUND/INVALID is unsatisfied but not false or unequal.

dynamic_event_dispatch.construction: event_dispatch Link from Function to explicit members-based dispatch domain Entity; selector_ref points to Data containing exact canonical Event Property.id; Function logic emits through dispatch_ref
dynamic_event_dispatch.rule: Selected Event owner must be a direct domain member. Target Function remains reached only through ordinary event_handler semantics.

filesystem_mutation.construction: Effect effect_type_ref=filesystem_mutation plus explicit operation and effect_target Links with target_role

persistence_mutation.construction: Effect effect_type_ref=persistence_mutation plus explicit backend and target effect_target roles

network_io.construction: Effect effect_type_ref=network_io with operation send/respond, at least one input_ref and explicit endpoint target
network_io.inbound_rule: Network data arrival is modeled with Event/Data semantics, not network_io receive Effect.

resource_lifecycle.construction: Effect effect_type_ref=resource_lifecycle with explicit resource target

blocked_gap_mapping.cw_semantic: event_dispatch with canonical Event Property.id selector and members domain
event_dispatch with canonical Event Property.id selector and members domain
filesystem_mutation plus ordinary Event continuation semantics
network_io for outbound I/O; Event/Data for inbound arrival; resource_lifecycle for network resource lifecycle
